parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the laboratory experiment as a research method and outline how it was used in the
Bandura et al study.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Design an alternative study to the Bandura et al study using the field experiment method and
describe how it could be conducted.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Evaluate this alternative way of studying aggression in practical and ethical terms.

text: Bandura et al (aggression) conducted a laboratory experiment to investigate the imitation of an
aggressive role model in young children. An alternative way to investigate this would be to conduct
a field experiment, for example, in a school.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe one piece of qualitative data from the Rosenhan study.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Discuss the strengths and weaknesses of making generalisations from the study by
Rosenhan.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Compare and contrast the use of quantitative and qualitative data using Rosenhan’s study as
an example. 
Section B (20 marks)
Answer one question from this section.

text: Rosenhan (sane in insane places) carried out a participant observation in a mental institution.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Outline what is meant by the ‘physiological approach’ in psychology. 
Using the studies from the list below, answer the questions which follow.
Dement and Kleitman (sleep and dreaming)
Maguire et al (taxi drivers)
Demattè et al (smells and facial attractiveness)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe how the data were collected in each of these studies.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: What problems may psychologists have when they investigate the physiological approach?

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Outline what is meant by the term ‘psychometric test’. 
Using the studies from the list below, answer the questions which follow.
Baron-Cohen et al (eyes test)
Thigpen and Cleckley (multiple personality disorder)
Billington et al (empathising and systemising)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the use of a psychometric test in each of these studies.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
What are the advantages of using psychometric tests?
